customManagers.description: The cmake product shipyard's launchers run and its pkg requires (components/cmake/version). install@v1 installs this release, verified against its SHA256SUMS; a bump releases shipyard on green.
The ed25519-sign that signs every family release (scripts/ed25519.pin). sign_and_appcast.sh verifies the pkg against the release's SHA256SUMS.
The stevedore packager (scripts/stevedore.pin). fetch_stevedore.sh verifies the asset against the release's SHA256SUMS.
The Renovate release that validates default.json in CI (scripts/renovate.pin, run by linux-host.yml). Pinned so the check does not move without a commit.

packageRules.description: The renovate pin moves at most monthly: each bump costs macOS runner time in shipyard's CI and then its release, and the validator gains nothing from tracking Renovate's every release.
schedule: on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: linux-host.yml's setup-node runs Renovate's own config validator, whose package requires node ^24.11.0, so node stays on 24 until a renovate pin needs another major.
